description: Shared utility functions and types for media understanding, including HTTP request handling, fetch with timeout, error response reading, and request configuration resolution.

methods.name: resolveGuardedHttpTimeoutMs
methods.description: Resolves the HTTP timeout in milliseconds, defaulting if input is invalid.

methods.name: sanitizeAuditContext
methods.description: Sanitizes and trims the audit context string.

methods.name: resolveProviderHttpRequestConfig
methods.description: Builds and resolves the provider HTTP request configuration based on input parameters.

methods.name: fetchWithTimeoutGuarded
methods.description: Performs a fetch with a guarded timeout and optional SSRF policies.

methods.name: postTranscriptionRequest
methods.description: Sends a POST request for transcription with optional private network allowance and audit context.

methods.name: postJsonRequest
methods.description: Sends a POST request with JSON body, with optional private network allowance and audit context.

methods.name: readErrorResponse
methods.description: Reads and extracts error message from an HTTP response.

methods.name: assertOkOrThrowHttpError
methods.description: Checks if response is OK; throws error with details if not.

methods.name: requireTranscriptionText
methods.description: Ensures a transcription text is present and trimmed, throws if missing.
